explication: Dozzle is a live container-monitoring application: users connect to its web interface, select containers or hosts, and view streaming logs and resource statistics without searching a retained log archive. Its runtime gathers data through Docker-compatible, Kubernetes, Swarm, and remote-agent services; the web layer also exposes search, actions, authentication, and related APIs. Notifications and cloud/MCP integrations extend monitoring beyond interactive viewing. The map uses documented capabilities and the sampled entry points; several handler-to-service details are inferred from the product structure, so uncertain internal links are omitted.
